links.comparator_used: Healthcare professionals diagnosing without the AI assisting tool
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and precision of 11 healthcare professionals, with vs without BiTNet assistance
links.effect: Mean accuracy 0.74 vs 0.50 and precision 0.61 vs 0.46 (p<0.001); improvement seen at all four experience levels
links.quote: The mean accuracy and precision of the participants with BiTNet as an assisting tool (0.74 and 0.61, respectively) are statistically higher than those of participants without the assisting tool (0.50 and 0.46, respectively (p<0.001)).

design_hint: AI assistance for clinician reading (reader study) and probability-threshold auto-prescreening
